name: AdCP 3.2 presented JWK is scoped to governance signing, adcp_use != request-signing (content-digest covered)
spec_reference: #verifier-checklist-requests step 8; AdCP 3.2 profile per #content-digest-and-proxy-compatibility and #adcp-rfc-9421-profile binary value encoding
$comment: 3.2-profile counterpart of negative/009-key-ops-missing-verify.json. AdCP 3.2 profile: the signature covers content-digest, binary values use RFC 8941 sf-binary (standard padded Base64), and the verifier advertises covers_content_digest='required'. The keyid test-gov-2026 resolves to a JWK in keys.json with adcp_use='governance-signing'. Per step 8, the verifier MUST reject because adcp_use is not 'request-signing'. Signature is the 64-zero-byte placeholder (step-ordering canary): the targeted check runs before cryptographic verification, so a verifier that verifies first returns request_signature_invalid instead of the expected code. Generated by scripts/generate-request-signing-profile-3.2-vectors.mjs from the test keys in keys.json; do not hand-edit.
